# DAVIDsTEA

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Canadian tea brand with an online store selling loose-leaf tea, matcha, teaware, gifts and advent calendars. The site offers Canada and United States selectors in English and French, with free shipping over 75 dollars and a flat rate under that.
